jobs.description:
**Description**
The Amazon Purchase Experience team is seeking a full stack software development engineer with a passion for engineering excellence. We offer you the opportunity to deliver and lead high visibility & high-impact innovation for customers across the Cart application services in Amazon. We extend to you the opportunity to develop upon multi-tiered, low-latency, highly resilient distributed systems on a grand scale. You will play a pivotal role in crafting solutions that profoundly enhance the shopping experience, handling vast data volumes, delivering lightning-fast response times, and simplifying the cart process to a remarkable degree. You must understand the importance of quality and testability in regards to the long term health and operational excellence of the Amazon eco system and you will be expected to drive improvements to current and future systems in these areas. You will contribute to both functional and non-functional aspects of the application in the form of enhancing customer experience, improving latency, performance, and business investigations. You will learn and grow by working closely with senior engineers across our organisation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have excellent technical design, problem solving, Computer Science fundamentals, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. The ability to work backwards and think from a customer perspective is crucial as the ideal candidate is expected to contribute to the product vision in addition to the technical design and implementation.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and develop full-stack solutions for Cart/Checkout services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi-tiered distributed systems
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
* Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data-driven analysis and experimentation
* Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and participate actively in design and architecture discussions

A day in the life
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long-term health.
  
  
**About The Team**
We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Core Technology
jobs.description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
Stripe Infrastructure is responsible for the reliability, scale, performance, and cost of Stripe's systems and the productivity and sentiment of Stripe's people. You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas including
  
  

* Core Infrastructure—We're the home for Stripe's critical tier-0 infrastructure systems (Compute, Networking, DocumentDB, Distributed Caching, and High assurance engineering). We build the foundational platform for Stripe products and services to allow them to operate at scale. We drive reliability, availability, efficiency, and scalability of these systems.
* Developer Infrastructure—We're responsible for the productivity of all developers at Stripe. We ensure Stripe's engineers have a reliable inner dev loop to maximize productivity while building everything from low-latency microservices to large-scale data pipelines and machine learning models.
* Security—We're a newly formed security team tasked with building the guardrails to extend Stripe's secure platform, allowing engineers to leverage new technologies that best meet their needs. We work on enabling new technologies for product and platform teams, prioritizing business needs as well as building the tooling and controls that further enable self-serve, guaranteeing we maintain a high bar across all Stripe surfaces with security in-built into foundations.
* Application and Revenue Platform—We build the powerful and scalable infrastructure that powers the company's application offerings and supports the processing and management of global transaction volumes.

Team Matching—exact team matching for one of the sub-teams within one of these organizations will begin during final stages. Please note we may also consider you for different organizations based on your experience, location, etc.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
We're looking for software engineers who are interested in building software services and platforms that impact thousands of employees and millions of Stripe users, regardless of whether they're an end user, developer, or partner. You'll work on projects that span technologies, systems, and processes where you'll design, build, test, and ship great code every day.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build a great customer experience for internal and external Stripe teams using our infrastructure
* Participate in roadmap planning and prioritization
* Deliver value through a strong collaborative approach with multiple customers and stakeholders across Stripe
* Debug production issues across services and several levels of the stack

Who you are
  
  
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 7+ years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops)
* Ability to write well-factored algorithms and experience with commonly used data structures and algorithms
* Hands-on experience contributing to or building large-scale distributed systems
* Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand engineers learn new languages on the job, so our interview process is language agnostic)
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success
* Ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility, with an entrepreneurial mindset
* Interest in working as a generalist across varying technologies and stacks to solve problems and delight both internal and external users

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience optimizing the end-to-end performance of distributed systems
* Focus on the needs of our users, both internal and external
* Hold yourself and others to a high bar when working with production

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

**Role Summary**
Are you an early-career software engineer who cares about writing good code and wants to learn from experienced engineers while building systems that matter?
  
  
Join us at FTSE Russell! We’re building a team of engineers passionate about software craftsmanship, quality, and continuous improvement. As an Associate Software Engineer, you’ll contribute to the software that powers indices trusted by financial institutions worldwide, working alongside experienced engineers who will help you develop your technical skills and engineering judgement.
  
  
We build primarily in Python, so experience with Python is valuable — but we’re equally interested in strong programming fundamentals and your ability to learn. If you’ve worked with Java, C#, C, C++, Scala, Go, Rust, or another modern programming language and are motivated to develop your Python skills, we’d like to hear from you.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role. You’ll write, test, review, and improve production software as part of an experienced engineering team. You’ll learn how well-designed software is built and operated in practice — from clean code and automated testing to APIs, databases, cloud services, observability, and production support.
  
  
You won’t be expected to know everything from day one. We’re looking for engineers with solid foundations, curiosity, and the willingness to learn, ask questions, take feedback, and gradually take ownership of increasingly complex work.
  
  
If you’re excited about developing as a software engineer while building systems used in global financial markets, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
We’re building the next-generation index data platform at FTSE Russell — and you’ll help us build it:
  
  

* Writing clean, maintainable production code, primarily in Python, with guidance and support from more experienced engineers
* Building and enhancing software components, services, APIs, and shared libraries as part of a collaborative engineering team
* Writing automated tests and learning how to build software that is reliable, secure, and easy to maintain
* Participating in code reviews — learning from feedback on your own code and gradually developing the skills to review the work of others
* Investigating bugs and production issues, understanding root causes, and implementing well-tested fixes
* Working with relational databases such as Aurora PostgreSQL, learning good practices around data modelling, queries, and schema evolution
* Developing software running on AWS using technologies such as Lambda, containerised services, object storage, and other managed AWS services
* Contributing to data-intensive applications that process significant volumes of financial and index data
* Using CI/CD pipelines and development tooling to build, test, and deploy software safely
* Learning how observability, logging, monitoring, and quality controls help us operate reliable production systems
* Working closely with engineers, product colleagues, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver useful solutions
* Taking part in design discussions and learning how experienced engineers evaluate technical options and trade-offs
* Building knowledge of financial indices and understanding how the software you develop supports our customers

Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.
  
  
Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.
  
  
Your role
  
  
Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.
  
  
To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
* Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.
* Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

**Minimum Requirements**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience).
* Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
* Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).
* Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.
* Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.
* Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge.
* Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.
* Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.
* Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.
* Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

**Software Stability Expert / CoC System Health, Stability**
============================================================

**Unit and team Overview**
--------------------------

Infotainment platforms unit is responsible for developing, maintaining and deploying BMW infotainment platform. BMW infotainment platform is Linux (Yocto) based SW platform that provides common automotive functions used by multiple automotive ECUs. The unit is also responsible for cross-cutting concerns of the platform, like architecture, security, stability and performance. The platform is deployed into multiple infotainment domain ECUs, ranging from headunits and rear seat entertainment systems to telematics and audio ECUs.

### **Stability**

The Center of Competence (CoC) 'System Health, Stability' is responsible for monitoring and analyzing stability problems (e.g., system resets, application crashes) for multiple infotainment projects. We automatically scan and pre-filter all logs from test drives to detect stability problems early during development. Supported by a defect front desk, we process more than 1000 stability tickets per month. In conjunction with the development teams, the team expediates solutions to these problems and supports in root cause analysis. As the stability problems need to be solved by the individual teams, a close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders is essential.

**Job Description**
-------------------

As part of the Stability and System Engineering team, you will help ensure the reliability and performance of next-generation Linux- and Android-based automotive control units. A key focus of your role will be defect management: analyzing issues reported during integration, validation, and vehicle drive testing; identifying root causes; and coordinating effective fixes across teams.

You will work closely with architects, software developers, integration teams, test engineers, and management to assess the impact and priority of defects, provide timely status updates, and improve the stability of software deliveries.

* Manage stability-related defects throughout the software delivery lifecycle, from issue intake and triage through root-cause analysis, resolution, and verification.
* Perform first-hand analysis of high-priority defects, establish their impact and reproducibility, and drive timely investigation with the responsible teams.
* Investigate complex issues involving system stability, performance, boot sequence, memory management, CPU utilization, resource usage, and system services.
* Analyze defects across the Linux kernel, Android framework, HAL, middleware, drivers, and applications.
* Conduct root-cause analysis using debugging, tracing, profiling, and system-analysis tools.
* Analyze crash dumps, kernel panics, ANRs, tombstones, watchdog resets, memory leaks, and other stability-related evidence.
* Review drive-test findings and provide a daily summary of results, including key defects, severity, trends, open risks, and progress, for management and relevant stakeholders.
* Track defect status, ownership, dependencies, and resolution progress, and communicate risks and blockers clearly.
* Create automation scripts and engineering tools for stability analysis, log collection, debugging, and performance monitoring.
* Collaborate with management, architecture, development, integration, validation, and customer teams to resolve critical platform issues.
* Identify recurring defect patterns and drive continuous improvements in platform reliability, performance, and software quality through data-driven analysis.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required Experience and Skills**

* A university degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a similar field.
* Strong understanding of Linux and Android embedded-system architecture.
* Hands-on experience with the Linux kernel, Android framework, system services, boot process, and resource management.
* Strong knowledge of software debugging, tracing, profiling, and performance-analysis tools such as GDB, perf, ftrace, strace, Perfetto, ADB, Logcat, and kernel logs.
* Experience analyzing system crashes, memory leaks, deadlocks, race conditions, kernel panics, ANRs, and performance bottlenecks.
* Good understanding of operating-system concepts, including processes, threads, scheduling, cgroups, namespaces, containers, IPC mechanisms, and memory management.
* Experience developing software with C/C++, Python, and shell scripting.
* Experience with defect triage and tracking, issue prioritization, root-cause analysis, and communicating technical findings to different audiences.

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level  
Industry: Software Development

  

Min Experience: 3+ years  
Location: Bengaluru, Chennai  
JobType: full-time

We are looking for a skilled Platform Backend Engineer to build and scale the backend infrastructure that powers enterprise AI and supply chain decision-intelligence products. The role involves developing core platform services, reusable APIs, execution frameworks, and agentic systems that enable product teams and AI agents to operate reliably in production.

You will take ambiguous technical problems from initial design through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement. The work spans core backend platform engineering and the agentic layer, including frameworks for building and orchestrating AI agents and the agents built on top of them.

Hiring is open at both Senior and Staff levels, with the level determined by the scope of ownership, technical depth, and impact demonstrated.

  

**About the Platform**
----------------------

The platform enables enterprises to solve complex supply chain challenges using AI-driven decision intelligence. It combines ready-to-use AI capabilities for network optimization, inventory allocation, route scheduling, fulfillment planning, order promising, demand forecasting, prediction, and scenario analysis with a flexible development platform.

Business and technical users can build and refine solutions using no-code tools, custom code, or extensible platform components. The engineering team focuses on providing the scalable, composable infrastructure that makes these capabilities reliable and accessible to enterprise customers.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own platform capabilities end to end, from problem definition and architectural design to development, release, and continuous iteration.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and reusable execution patterns that other engineering teams can build upon.
* Develop robust data models and handle concurrency, failure recovery, performance optimization, and observability.
* Build and improve the frameworks used to develop, execute, and orchestrate AI agents.
* Develop production-ready agent loops, tool integrations, orchestration mechanisms, and user-facing experiences built on agentic systems.
* Translate ambiguous business and technical requirements into practical, maintainable engineering solutions.
* Debug complex production issues, identify root causes, and improve system reliability based on real-world behaviour.
* Make sound technical decisions around system design, APIs, databases, and underlying execution mechanisms.
* Collaborate with product teams and other engineers to deliver reusable platform capabilities that support multiple downstream consumers.
* Take ownership of production systems, monitor their performance, and evolve their architecture as requirements and usage change.
* Communicate design decisions, trade-offs, implementation details, and technical challenges clearly across teams.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**
--------------------------------------

* Strong fundamentals in backend engineering, including problem decomposition, data structures, low-level design, and debugging.
* Hands-on experience building and owning production-grade backend systems.
* Ability to explain system behaviour beyond the framework layer, including API design, database interactions, concurrency, and failure handling.
* Experience taking technical projects from initial design through production deployment and subsequent improvements.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous requirements without relying on predefined solutions.
* A practical, hands-on approach to engineering, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, trade-offs, and production incidents.
* Experience working in a startup or similarly fast-paced environment where engineers are expected to take initiative and deliver end-to-end solutions.

**Must-Have Skills**
--------------------

* Backend Engineering
* Platform Engineering

**Good-to-Have Skills**
-----------------------

* Experience building developer platforms, workflow orchestration systems, or services consumed by multiple downstream teams.
* Familiarity with AI agent evaluation, tracing, tool integration, and cost-control mechanisms.
* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience designing reusable platform abstractions and execution frameworks.

**Location and Work Arrangement**
---------------------------------

**Location:** Bengaluru or Chennai  
**Work Model:** Hybrid

**Interview Process**
---------------------

The selection process consists of the following stages:

* Recruiter screening.

* Conversation with engineering leadership.

* Live system design and problem-solving round.

* Half-day in-office build exercise, where candidates can use AI tools of their choice and explain their implementation decisions.

* Build teardown and values conversation.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
